charts.title: HD 80653 b: orbits around HD 80653
charts.description: The orbits of HD 80653's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 80653 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Naponiello et al. 2026 (2026arXiv260719325N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NAPONIELLO_ET_AL_2026): P 0.71957926 d

charts.title: HD 80653 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 80653 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (45, 46) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 55315929, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
